meta.description: Full ALAS Latin Tour calendar. Register for events, browse categories and check your registrations.

events.ready: Ready for your next stop on the tour.
events.title: 2026 Events & Calendar
events.intro: Every stop of the continental professional surf circuit.
events.noConfirmed: No confirmed competitors for this selection yet.
events.noInscriptions: You don't have any active registrations yet.
events.starsHelp: Stars show the event level (1 to 7, the top level is called "Prime"): the higher the number, the more ranking points it awards.
events.openHelp: Registration is open — spots are still available.
events.soonHelp: Date confirmed, registration not open yet.
events.rulesSupportText: Check the official rules or contact support with questions about registration and payments.

inscription.title: Event registration
inscription.intro: Complete the 3 steps to secure your spot on the ALAS Latin Tour 2026 circuit.
inscription.verifyData: Check that your details are correct.
inscription.rulesConsent: I confirm that I have read and accept the event rules and the ALAS circuit policies.
inscription.riskConsent: I accept the risks inherent in taking part in a surf competition and release the organization from liability under the event conditions.
inscription.imageConsent: I authorize the organization to use photos and videos taken during the event for communication, press and promotion of the circuit.
inscription.selectCategoryText: Choose the category you want to compete in.
inscription.paymentMethodText: Choose how you want to pay for your registration.
inscription.adminFeeNote: If an administrative fee applies, it will be added to the total and shown in your registration confirmation.
inscription.existingMembership: You already have an active {{ plan }} membership
inscription.existingAnnual: It covers every circuit event this season. You don't need to pay for it again.
inscription.existingPerEvent: It covers every category in this event. You don't need to pay for it again.
inscription.membershipOptionalText: Add it to your registration if you don't have an active membership yet.
inscription.paypalRedirect: You'll be redirected to PayPal's secure checkout.
inscription.beachText: Pay when you arrive at the event. Requires administrative approval and a 24 h token.
inscription.tokenNotice: We'll notify the administrator. Once approved, you'll receive a token by email valid for 24 hours. If it expires, you'll need to request a new one.
inscription.beachFootnote: For beach payments, your spot is reserved but pending until you pay in person.
inscription.error: There was an error processing your registration. Please try again.

beach.title: Beach Payment
beach.intro: Registration with in-person payment at the event.
beach.requestText: When you click "Request code", we'll notify the circuit administrator. Once approved, you'll receive a single-use 24-hour token by email.

steps.s2: An admin approves it in the CMS
steps.s3: You receive a token by email
steps.s4: You enter the token here (valid 24 h)
steps.s5: You pay in cash when you arrive at the event

beach.haveTokenHint: If you've already received the code by email, you can enter it here.
beach.pendingText: Your request was sent to the administrator. You'll receive the token at your registered email once it's approved.
beach.pendingHint: The administrator will review your request and email you the token.
beach.receivedToken: Already received the token by email?
beach.enterText: Type the code you received by email.
beach.expiredText: The payment code has expired (24-hour validity). You can request a new token.
beach.confirmedText: Your spot is reserved. Remember to pay in cash when you arrive at the event.
beach.confirmedStatus: Your registration status will be Payment pending until it's validated in person.
beach.requestError: The request could not be sent. Please try again.
beach.invalidToken: The token you entered is invalid or has expired.
beach.verifyError: There was an error verifying the token.

paypal.confirmingText: We're validating your order with PayPal and recording your registration.
paypal.errorTitle: The payment could not be confirmed
paypal.cancelledText: You cancelled the payment on PayPal. Your registration was created but is pending payment.
paypal.missingData: We didn't receive the data needed to confirm the payment with PayPal.
paypal.captureError: An error occurred while confirming the payment with PayPal.

myInscriptions.deleteError: The registration could not be deleted.
